notes.title: 🎉 YUME5(General Direction) is officially launched! ❤️
notes.content:
[h2]🏡Game Background🏡:[/h2]
    Players step into a fantastical world woven from ancient times to the present, where modern Chen Xi fights side by side with her past-life characters, exploring a mysterious maze infused with Spring Festival elements. The collision between modern and ancient times is not just a visual feast, but also a profound dialogue of the soul.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185666/b1c67e2668bb6b635b62159825d2bbfd139b2824.png[/img]

[h2]💟 Game Introduction💟:[/h2]
The game features a unique dual-role control mechanism where players must simultaneously manage modern Chen Xi and her past-life characters, embarking on an exhilarating adventure in a mirrored maze. By using the WASD key to normally control the protagonist's movements, her previous life character acted in a mirrored manner, meaning that the player's input direction was opposite to their actual movement direction.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185666/efc5d03a4be34bc3d63c24cc5e397869a0f48b73.gif[/img]
There are 8 levels, each with two to three stages.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185666/f1eea032f2b4d0fb0e896146362149d6439740f9.png[/img]
[h3] Please note the countdown time for the overall game completion~ (Be careful not to fail the game!) )[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185666/cf99f671d69e558933c741be043dabc8f4bd745d.png[/img]
As the levels deepen, the complexity of the mirror maze increases, requiring players to flexibly switch control strategies, cleverly avoid obstacles, and team up with two characters to reach the finish line.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185666/93c4ff527176285f3cb2f889b4ecef22fa374e22.gif[/img]
Scene additions: character status, trap settings, interactive scenes/items.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185666/dbeda499628f1ced893f49dd4c12cbcc26fae6c1.png[/img]  [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185666/510b938973898f825777d6b877bc2b0524c131c2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185666/7743afb6c2e9fd769b9e665263679154f33b4861.png[/img]

‌    [*]Dual Theme Fusion💞: A Perfect Fusion of Spring Festival and Valentine's Day, Featuring Scenes and Clothing Ambiance to Meet Your Dual Expectations!
‌    [*]Convenient Experience⚡: Skip levels with one click, freely control the game rhythm, and enjoy gaming fun anytime, anywhere! [/list]
The character drawings in levels will feature different animated presentations under various trigger scenarios, with richer actions, expressions, and tones, allowing everyone to experience the game more deeply (√)
